title: Milestone screenshots
notes: Trigger wording ships exactly as decided in D-004; /scout:start lets each project redefine what "milestone" means, so the default only needs to be sane, not perfect.
instruction: After any stakeholder demo, or when a major feature first works end-to-end, prompt to capture screenshots of the working state. Save them inside the project with the date and a short label, so the build keeps a visual history of what worked when. Prompt, then capture — never screenshot silently.
